title: Image, QR, PE and YARA names of batch p2-G12-1 (image_metadata, pivots_geo_image, qr_decode, pe_triage, yara_scan)

attributes.image_summary: plain-language first line about an image's metadata (P259 c7): 'taken <date> with <make/model>, GPS present' or 'no EXIF metadata' (missing EXIF is normal and never a finding)
attributes.image_metadata: image metadata facts (P259): {format, width, height, dates, software, editing_software, xmp_history, iptc_place, thumbnail, anomalies, parser}; claims made by the file, editable
attributes.camera_make: camera manufacturer recorded in EXIF/XMP (claim made by the file)
attributes.camera_model: camera model recorded in EXIF/XMP (claim made by the file)
attributes.camera_serial: camera body serial number recorded in EXIF/XMP (privacy: stripped from STIX/MISP exports unless the analyst opts in for the case, P259 c6)
attributes.lens_serial: lens serial number recorded in EXIF/XMP (privacy: stripped from exports unless the analyst opts in, P259 c6)
attributes.image_software: software named by the image metadata (EXIF Software/ProcessingSoftware, XMP CreatorTool, PNG Software)
attributes.image_owner: owner fields of an image (EXIF Artist/Copyright/CameraOwnerName, XMP dc:creator/dc:rights, IPTC By-line/Copyright, PNG Author); personal data: stripped from exports unless the analyst opts in (P259 c6)
attributes.taken_at: capture time claimed by the image metadata (EXIF DateTimeOriginal, else XMP/IPTC), ISO 8601 with the recorded offset
attributes.last_changed_at: EXIF DateTime of an image: when the file was last changed by the camera or an editor
attributes.gps_altitude_m: GPS altitude in metres recorded in an image (privacy: shown only inside the case report)
attributes.gps_timestamp: GPS UTC time recorded in an image (privacy: shown only inside the case report)
attributes.xmp_document_id: XMP xmpMM:DocumentID of an image (links copies edited from the same document)
attributes.xmp_original_document_id: XMP xmpMM:OriginalDocumentID of an image (the first document an edit chain started from)
attributes.qr_summary: one line about the QR codes and barcodes decoded from an image (P261 c5): 'N code(s) decoded: <kinds>' or 'no QR/barcode found' (never 'clean')
attributes.qr_codes: QR codes and barcodes decoded from an image: list {format, kind, display (defanged), valid, truncated, route}; payload capped at 4 KB, Wi-Fi passwords and OTP secrets never kept
attributes.pe_summary: one line about a PE file (P271): type, machine, subsystem, compile time (with reliability), section/import counts, signature status
attributes.imphash: import-table hash of a PE file (pefile-compatible MD5); also an imphash pivot with expand=False
attributes.rich_header_hash: MD5 of the decoded Rich header of a PE file (VirusTotal rich_pe_header_hash semantics); attribute only, never a pivot (P271 c5)
attributes.rich_checksum_valid: whether the Rich header checksum of a PE file matches its DOS header and entries (a mismatch hints at a pasted/forged Rich header)
attributes.compile_time: COFF TimeDateStamp of a PE file as ISO 8601 (a claim by the linker; see compile_time_flags)
attributes.compile_time_flags: reliability flags of a PE compile time: zero, future, pre_2000, delphi_1992, debug_timestamp_differs (each = 'unreliable/forged'), reproducible_build (the field holds a build hash, not a date)
attributes.pe_machine: target machine of a PE file (i386, amd64, arm64...)
attributes.pe_subsystem: subsystem of a PE file (windows_gui, windows_cui, native, efi_application...)
attributes.pe_sections: sections of a PE file: list {name, entropy, raw_size, virtual_size, characteristics}
attributes.pe_imports: imports of a PE file: {dll: [function names or ordN]} (capped)
attributes.pe_signature: Authenticode facts of a PE file: {present, status 'signed, not verified', signers [{subject, issuer, serial, not_before, not_after, sha256}], timestamped}; no validity claim of any kind (P271 c4)
attributes.pe_packer_hints: packer and obfuscation hints of a PE file (section names, entropy, W+X, overlay...): context, never a verdict; downgraded to info when a known-good source in the case lists the hash (P271 c7)
attributes.export_dll_name: DLL name recorded in a PE export directory
attributes.pdb_path: PDB path recorded in a PE debug directory (privacy: usernames and machine names inside it are never username entities, P271 c6)
attributes.pdb_username: user name found in a PE's PDB path (privacy attribute; never a username entity or username check, P271 c6)
attributes.pdb_machine: machine name found in a PE's UNC PDB path (privacy attribute; never an entity, P271 c6)
attributes.yara_hits: YARA rule hits on a local file: list {rule, original_name, rule_set, author, reference, source_url, score, package_version, licence, kind generic|family|specific, label, strings (identifiers, counts, offsets; never the matched bytes)}
attributes.yara_coverage: YARA coverage table of a scan: rules loaded / excluded (licence) / excluded (dependency) / failed to compile, package name and version, licence classes allowed (P272 c2, c4)

tags.edited_image: image metadata names editing software, an EXIF thumbnail whose aspect ratio differs from the main image, or a change after capture: context, not proof (EXIF can be edited)
tags.qr_code: value decoded from a QR code or barcode in an image (quishing triage; decoded URLs are never fetched or opened)
tags.packer_hint: PE packer/obfuscation hint (section name, entropy, W+X, overlay): context, never a verdict
tags.unreliable_timestamp: a timestamp that is zero, in the future, before 2000, the Delphi 1992 constant or contradicted by another field: unreliable/forged
tags.yara_match: a YARA rule matched a local file (rule hit, never a verdict on its own)

relations.photo_taken_at: image file -> GPS coordinates recorded in its EXIF/XMP metadata (privacy; never auto-expanded, no automatic geocoding)
relations.qr_payload: image file -> value decoded from a QR code or barcode in it (never fetched or opened)
relations.yara_family_rule: local file -> malware family named by the family meta of a family-specific YARA rule that matched it (low confidence)
